description: Check one name (e.g. "acme") across several TLDs at once and return availability plus the best 2-year price for each. Defaults to .com, .net, .io, .ai, .dev, .app. Max 8 TLDs per call.

name.description: The name without a TLD, e.g. "acme".

tlds.description: TLDs to check, without or with a leading dot. Default: com, net, io, ai, dev, app.
